thread:
San Jose State has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than any other big Cal State, 61 more than No. 2.

Every Cal State campus with 20,000+ students:

1. San Jose State: 140
2. CSUN: 79
3. SF State: 62
4. San Diego State: 40
5. Cal State Fullerton: 37
6. Sacramento State: 31
7. Cal State LA: 14
8. Long Beach State: 11
9. Fresno State: 9
10. Cal Poly SLO: 4

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/ca

How to tell a good taqueria before you order:

Look at the tortillas first. Fresh corn tortillas pressed and griddled to order are the biggest difference there is.

Three more signs:

- Three or four house salsas, not one bottle of hot sauce
- A short menu: five or six fillings
- Onion, cilantro and lime on top, nothing else

New place? If there's a spit of pork with pineapple turning, order al pastor.

More on what to order: https://www.savorscout.net/food/tacos
